# Lehsun — Nostalgic North Indian Catering & Daily Food Service

> Lehsun is a 5-star rated North Indian catering specialist based in Ebbsfleet Valley, Kent, United Kingdom. We serve home-style North Indian cuisine for private events, birthdays, housewarmings, baby showers, Diwali celebrations, corporate events, and family gatherings across Dartford, Gravesend, Ebbsfleet Valley, Northfleet, Bexley, Orpington, and nearby Kent.

## 2. Service Offerings & Pricing Structure

### Event Catering
- **Starting Price**: From £11.99 per head.
- **Minimum Guest Count**: 12 guests.
- **Maximum Event Capacity**: Up to 125 guests.
- **Quote Lead Time**: Same-day custom tailored quotes provided via WhatsApp or email.
- **Event Types Covered**: Birthdays, housewarmings, baby showers, Diwali, Holi, Christmas, Easter, anniversaries, corporate events, mandir events, Satyanarayan Katha, weddings, and family gatherings.

### Kitchen Facilities & Dietary Standards
- **Separate Kitchen Facilities**: We maintain separate kitchen facilities for vegetarian and non-vegetarian food prep, so pure vegetarian and Jain guests can order with confidence.
- **Dietary Accommodations**: Vegetarian, pure vegetarian, Jain, no-onion/no-garlic, non-vegetarian, and custom spice level adjustments.

### Daily Food Menu (Local DA10 & Nearby)
- Fresh North Indian dishes posted daily on WhatsApp.
- Available for local collection from Ebbsfleet Valley (DA10) or local delivery within 2 miles for orders above £25.

## 3. Catering Menu Items & Signature Dishes

### Starters (Vegetarian & Non-Vegetarian)
- **Samosa Chole Chaat**: Crispy spiced potato samosas topped with tangy Delhi-style Pindi Chole, yogurt, and mint-tamarind chutneys.
- **Dahi Bhalle**: Soft lentil dumplings soaked in sweetened yogurt, topped with roasted cumin and tangy chutneys.
- **Paneer Tikka**: Marinated cottage cheese cubes grilled with bell peppers and onions.
- **Honey Chilli Potatoes**: Crispy fried potato fingers tossed in a sweet-spicy garlic sauce.
- **Aloo Kachori**: Crispy stuffed lentil & potato bread served with tangy chutney.
- **Chicken Tikka**: Tender boneless chicken marinated in yogurt and North Indian tandoori spices.
- **Amritsari Fish Fry**: Crispy spiced fish fillets fried in gram flour batter.

### Main Courses (Vegetarian)
- **Dal Makhani**: Slow-cooked black lentils simmered overnight with cream, butter, and aromatics.
- **Paneer Butter Masala**: Soft cottage cheese cubes cooked in a rich tomato, butter, and cashew gravy.
- **Delhi's Pindi Chole**: Authentic dark, tangy chickpeas simmered with whole tea leaves and roasted spices.
- **Dum Aloo**: Slow-cooked baby potatoes in a spiced yogurt-based gravy.
- **Shahi Paneer**: Rich royal curry cooked with paneer in a creamy saffron-infused gravy.

### Main Courses (Non-Vegetarian)
- **Delhi's Butter Chicken**: Authentic Delhi-style tandoori chicken cooked in a rich tomato, butter, and cream sauce.
- **Kashmiri Rogan Josh**: Tender mutton slow-cooked in a fragrant fennel-ginger Kashmiri red chili gravy.
- **Shahi Patiala Chicken**: Rich Punjab-style chicken curry with ground spices and cream.
- **Old Delhi's Nihari**: Velvety slow-cooked beef or lamb stew cooked with whole aromatic spices.
- **Dhaba Mutton Curry**: Rustic highway-style mutton curry packed with bold garlic and ginger notes.

### Breads, Rice & Desserts
- **Breads**: Tandoori Butter Naan, Garlic Naan, Fresh Poori, Tandoori Roti.
- **Rice**: Vegetable Dum Biryani, Chicken Dum Biryani, Jeera Rice, Peas Pulao.
- **Sides**: Boondi Raita, Cucumber Mint Raita, Fresh Green Salad, Mixed Pickles.
- **Desserts**: Shahi Tukda with Rabdi, Hot Gulab Jamun, Phirni, Rice Kheer, Gajar Halwa, Fresh Fruit Cream.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is included in Lehsun catering?**  
A: Catering menus can include veg and non-veg starters, main courses, rice/pulao, breads, raita, salads, and traditional desserts. All food is freshly prepared for your event date.

**Q: Do you use separate kitchens for veg and non-veg food?**  
A: Yes — we use separate kitchen setups for vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, ensuring pure vegetarian guests can order with complete confidence.

**Q: What is the minimum group size for catering?**  
A: Event catering starts at 12 guests. For smaller individual or family meals, our daily menu is available for local DA10 pickup/delivery.

**Q: How far in advance should I book?**  
A: We recommend booking 1 to 2 weeks in advance for weekend events and birthdays, though same-day or short-notice quotes are often available via WhatsApp.
